ko.executive_summary: PicoJool and industry players are advancing optical interconnect architectures targeting 12.8T AI workloads, with optical switching gaining prominence in data center deployments. Nvidia's investment in South Korean AI startups (Motif, Upstage, Realworld, Poin2) signals ecosystem expansion, though direct CPO technology linkage is unclear.
key_facts: PicoJool: optical interconnects for 12.8T AI era
UTStarcom: optical switching for AI data centers
Nvidia investing in four South Korean AI startups: Motif, Upstage, Realworld, Poin2

implications.text: AI infrastructure is driving demand for higher-speed optical interconnects beyond current 1.6T/3.2T standards, positioning next-gen CPO/optical switching as critical for cluster connectivity.
UTStarcom's focus on optical switching for AI data centers indicates growing adoption of photonic switching fabrics as alternative to electronic switching bottlenecks.
Nvidia's South Korean startup investments may signal interest in regional optical/AI component innovation, though impact on CPO/optical comms supply chain unclear.

ko.counterpoint: Nvidia announcement focuses on AI software/algorithm startups rather than optical hardware, so direct relevance to CPO market is speculative.
